THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
079
Behind the image
37 / Infinity Print
REFERENCE 5792.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 029
Art direction: 1970s boho revival, warm honey tones, deep plum print, saturated color blur behind.
Photorealistic vertical runway close-up of an original adult woman with very long, straight
honey-blonde hair parted in the center, flyaway strands catching the light, pale blue eyes, defined
brows and warm terracotta-rose lips. She wears a deep aubergine long-sleeve peasant-style top
with a ruffled neckline and a repeating lilac and white interlocking knot print, layered with a long
gold chain necklace and a beaded tassel pendant. Warm blurred background of red, yellow and
charcoal stage shapes, soft frontal runway light, shallow depth of field, 1970s bohemian revival,
rich plum and honey palette, sharp detail on print and jewelry, no text or logos.
38 / Quilted Crimson
REFERENCE 5797.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 030
Art direction: Navy and rust against black, tactile contrast of quilting, knit and fleece, raw natural
hair and skin.
Photorealistic vertical runway beauty close-up of an original adult woman with tousled, mid-length
auburn-brown hair and flyaway strands, pale gray-green eyes, strong natural brows, luminous
skin and soft nude lips, looking at the camera. She wears a navy ribbed roll-neck under
diamond-quilted navy panels with leather piping, framed by a textured rust-red shearling-style
outer layer. Pure black backdrop, soft directional light, navy and rust palette, tactile fabric detail,
no text or logos.
